goal: Complete General_Sepsis_V11 build, validation, poster package, and master notebook with evidence-backed outputs

messages.body: Run cohort token audit for GSE54514, GSE57065, GSE95233, GSE26378 and fallback GSE134347. Emit counts for include/exclude by class and timepoint.
GSE95233 strict admission parsing produced 0 sepsis D00 samples; deterministic fallback to GSE134347 (healthy+sepsis only) executed and logged.
All required deliverable files present; final checklist recorded. Note: hard pass gate all_passed=false due model-vs-baseline delta criterion.
Two-pass policy completed: smoke gate run first, then full 5-fold training run with epochs=60 and patience=20.

D1.acceptance: compilable tex and produced PDF output
D1.summary: engineering_notebook_master.tex and engineering_notebook_master.pdf generated with methods, math, inventories, changelog, failure analysis, and code appendix listings.
D1.title: Build master engineering_notebook_master.tex with code appendix inventory

I1.title: Build 01_download_and_preprocess.py and generate harmonized matrices

I3.title: Build 03_train_v11_general_sepsis.py with SGKF + V11 architecture

I4.summary: 04_evaluate.py rerun after full training: holdout metrics, bootstrap CI, permutation test, baseline comparison, and gate outputs updated.
I4.title: Build 04_evaluate.py with holdout CI permutation and baselines
